notes: The ASV renders `וְעַל־הַצֹּאן יָזִיז הַהַגְרִי` at the end of its verse 30, so s001–s007 are `unrepresented` here and the corresponding English is `added` in v30 (rule 10).

The fused `לְ` + `דָּוִיד` unit is discontinuous around the written `מֶלֶךְ`. The competing reading fuses the preposition with `מֶלֶךְ` instead; it is set aside because *king* carries no genitive relation, so rule 30's condition that the shared word carry every morpheme's sense would fail, while *David's* carries both the belonging and the name and rule 35's distance clause keeps the fusion across the intervening noun.
